countingRule: Passing test executions across four overlapping suites, not 919 distinct test cases. Final ledger-digest checks are reported separately after this file is pinned.

resolvedInitialFindings.detail: One shared KZ assertion still required 16-digit after the legally sourced metadata correction. Changed only that KZ assertion to 16-character and reran all four suites; each is now passing.

The user-global npm entrypoint was broken and npm default cmd could not resolve node. Used the installed Node/npm CLI with an explicit PowerShell script shell; npm run postal-context:m2:status passes without changing user configuration.

m2DefinitionBasis.rule: Formalize the pre-existing assignment-plus-independent-geometry and RKA/building-link review conditions; preserve all ten hard blockers. Point geometry is allowed; no forced polygon and no automatic address/building relation.

criterion.definition: Current rights-cleared typed QazPost assignments and independently licensed point or area geometry pass complete declared coverage, current-versus-legacy validity, CRS/topology, RKA/building-link review, privacy, jurisdiction, freshness and digest gates, with reproducible transformation, immutable publication and actual AGID loader/API verification.

digestConvention: UTF-8 LF canonical Git text for testedTextFiles and source report; actual bytes for captured documents and logs. The engineering report and mutable ledger are excluded from their own hash list to avoid circular hashes; the final ledger pins this engineering report.
